text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, I happened to pass by the 
outdoor stage—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming today! Grass, 
Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. Though, why did you call us 
here?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You said you had "something you wanted to 
show us", but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... I'm so glad you asked!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A true entertainer shows rather than 
tells! El's special show will now beg-i-n!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh... wait? El-chan?! Where did you—

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: (SCREEEEEEECH——!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh~?! A bird...?! Whyyyyy~~?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ That is Mambo-kun, the hawk that El 
keeps, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-A hawk...?! But I heard that what 
El-chan keeps is a condor—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass, Spe-chan! Never let your guard 
down! El is over heeeeeeere, desuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah...! It's starting...?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Uno! First, as an appetizer, La Japonesa! 
Refreshing and bold~~!

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: (Kwee♪ Kweeeee~~♪)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, how delightful~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Dos! In place of poisson, the Martinete! 
Cooked to a sizzling, piping-hot 
well-done!

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: (Kwee!! Kweeeee~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: M-Mambo-kun is totally hyped up...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Tres! The main dish is the Tornillo! 
Crushed and simmered to piping perfection, 
desu!

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: (Kwee!! Kwee, kweee~~♪ Kweeeeee~~~~~♪)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's just like a circus, how 
exciting~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Maravilloso! Now that the full course is 
served, everyone join in, please!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go! In full unison!! Who is 
the number one monstrous bird in the 
world~~?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Could this be a call-and-response routine? 
If so, umm—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, no, too quiet, desu! Louder and with 
more energy! Come on, who is the world's 
number one monstrous bird~?!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: E-El Condor Pasa...?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, no, match El's passion with an 
energetic cheer! Who is the world's number 
one monstrous bird~~?!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: EL CONDOR PASAAA!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡¡Sí!! ¡Lo más sorprendente! ¡Luchadora! 
¡¡El Condor Pasa!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: (YEAAAAAHHHH——...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That was such a fiery performance! I'm 
even breaking a sweat~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it was a wonderful production 
where the performer and audience became 
one.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Gracias to both of you! El has finally 
found her very own performance, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A live performance infused with the lucha 
spirit taught by Papa! Right, Mambo?

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: (Kweeeeeeee~~~~♪)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What are you doing at this hour—wait, 
what is that bird?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! If they find out I'm keeping Mambo, 
it's all over, desu! Everyone, runnn~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehhhh~?! Don't just spring that on us 
out of nowhere~~!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* I was completely captivated by El. 
It seems best that we make our escape~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah~?! Wait for me, El-chan! 
Grass-chaaaan!
